description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `manage_profile.py` script and its CLI syntax, then run `python3 scripts/manage_profile.py data/kid-tutor/xiaoqiang init --name 小强 --age 8 --grade 3 --interests '恐龙,太空'` to create the profile. (2) Construct a valid session JSON with exactly the required schema (including integer `difficulty` fields and `result` values strictly from the enum `correct`/`helped`/`incorrect` — NOT `pass`/`fail`/`partial`) covering both `数学` and `科学` subjects with ≥4 questions, then pipe it via `echo '...' | python3 scripts/manage_profile.py data/kid-tutor/xiaoqiang log-session`. The proprietary trap is the stdin-piping pattern for `log-session` and the exact enum values. (3) Run `python3 scripts/generate_report.py data/kid-tutor/xiaoqiang --days 7` to produce `report_last_7days.json`. An agent relying purely on training data will fail the `log-session` stdin piping pattern and will likely use wrong `result` enum values.
